scripts.dev: npm run dev:ui & && npm run dev:api
scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm i && tsc && vite build
scripts.install: npm run install:ui && npm run install:api
scripts.test:api: cd api && echo "Error: no test specified" && exit 1
scripts.build:api: npm run install:api && npm run build:api:local && npm run build:api:production && npm run build:api:copy_files
scripts.build:api:copy_files: cd api && npx -y cpy-cli node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node build/ --flat && npx -y cpy-cli node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node build/local/build/Release/ --flat && npx -y cpy-cli db/insights/insights.db build/local/ --flat && npx -y cpy-cli store/ build/local/ && npx -y cpy-cli --flat --rename=.env ./.env.local build/local/ && npx -y cpy-cli --flat --rename=package.json ./.bundle-package.json build/local/
scripts.package: npm run build:api && cd ui && npm run electron:build
scripts.package:win: npm run build:api && cd ui && npm run electron:build:win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:api && cd ui && npm run electron:build:mac
